observations: Single photo shows a white plastic IBC (Intermediate Bulk Container) tote inside a galvanized metal cage frame, sitting on a plastic/metal pallet base.
Black screw-cap lid visible on top.
Watermark reads 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'WSA GLOBAL CONCEPTS' - these are seller/platform marks, not proof of item condition.
Cage shows some surface wear/dirt but no obvious major rust or bending from this angle.
No bottom outlet valve visible in this photo - camera angle does not show the base valve/spigot.
Background shows a truck bed and other items, suggesting a yard/dealer setting, not a studio shot.
No visible cracks, discoloration patterns from UV, or dents, but only one side/angle is shown.

identity.kind: 1000 liter IBC tote (plastic tank in metal cage, for water or diesel storage)

claims.evidence: No volume markings or manufacturer plate visible in photo 0; 1000L is the standard size for this tote shape, but cannot be confirmed from the image alone.

claims.claim: Suitable for water tank or diesel storage
claims.evidence: No information on prior contents of the tote is visible or stated beyond the seller's suggestion. IBC totes are often repurposed from chemical/food transport, which matters for safe reuse.

risks.risk: Unknown prior contents of the tote (could have held chemicals unsafe for potable water)
risks.proof: Photo of any manufacturer/content label or UN code plate usually found on the cage or tank shoulder
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown-origin/non-potable-grade, suitable only for diesel or non-food liquid storage

risks.risk: Condition of bottom outlet valve (missing, cracked, or seized)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the base/valve area from underneath or the side showing the spigot
risks.if_unproven: priced as if valve is missing or non-functional

risks.risk: Hairline cracks or UV brittleness in plastic not visible from this single angle
risks.proof: Photos from all four sides and the base, plus a shot of the tank lifted off the pallet
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/worst-case condition, not confirmed leak-free

risks.risk: Cage frame rust or structural weakness affecting ability to hold full 1000L safely
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all cage joints and the pallet base
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-only cage, not warrantied for full load-bearing use

proof_requests: Close-up of any manufacturer/UN code plate or label showing prior contents and actual rated volume
Photo of the bottom valve/spigot area
Photos of all four sides and underneath the tank, with tank removed from cage if possible
Photo showing the tank filled with water or a hose test to confirm no leaks
response.reason: This is a standard, identifiable-by-type used IBC tote; it can be priced at worst case (unverified prior contents, unverified valve condition, unverified capacity) with risks listed for upward adjustment once proof is supplied.
